opennyai_summary.decision:
3. After some argument, learned counsel for the applicant states that he may be permitted to withdraw this application filed under Section 528 BNSS with liberty to file bail application before the court below.
Under the circumstances, the present application under Section 528 BNSS is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to applicant to approach the court concerned for bail.
In order to enable the applicant to approach the court concerned for bail, for a period of 15 days, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicant.
In case, the bail application is preferred by the applicant before the court concerned, the court concerned shall decide the same expeditiously without granting unnecessary adjournment to any party.
6. The application under Section 528 BNSS is dismissed as withdrawn with the aforesaid liberty and direction.
